retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic portrait of a male subject against a twilight sky with a high-contrast blue and red color split and bold sans-serif typography.
triggerTerms: cinematic blue and red twilight portrait
bearded man in bomber jacket with bold text
excludeWhen: the request is for a minimalist white background
the request requires a vintage or sepia tone
the subject is a group or landscape only

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium-shot portrait of a bearded man looking over his shoulder, set against a deep blue twilight sky with a vibrant red light leak or gradient at the bottom, featuring centered bold and outlined sans-serif text.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's blue jacket blending into the sky background
Contrast between the solid white text and the outlined secondary text
Warm red light leak at the base contrasting with the cool blue upper half
Subject's gaze directed back toward the viewer over the shoulder
coreInvariants: High-contrast color split between cyan-blue and magenta-red
Bold, geometric sans-serif typography positioned horizontally across the center
Subject wearing a textured satin or nylon bomber jacket

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centrally located, captured from the waist up, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and beard serve as the primary focal point, anchored by the horizontal text line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's face, follows the line of the jacket down to the text, and then sweeps across the red gradient at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper corners and the area behind the subject provide open blue space for atmospheric depth.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues and reds with deep shadows and bright highlights on the subject's face.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to a tri-color scheme of blue, red, and white

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the primary name
Thin, consistent outline for the secondary title
Wide tracking for the outlined text
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Weight and fill contrast: Solid bold paired with outlined regular of the same typeface family.
graphicDevices: Horizontal text alignment across the mid-section

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric structure and modern feel.
Excellent geometric alternative with various weights for solid and outline pairing.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a bearded man in a blue bomber jacket looking over his shoulder against a twilight sky. Apply a heavy blue color grade to the top and a vibrant red/magenta light leak gradient to the bottom.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in a bold white geometric sans-serif font on the left-center, and the album title in a matching outlined white font with wide tracking on the right-center.

verificationChecks: Is there a clear color distinction between the blue top and red bottom?
Is the subject's jacket a satin-like blue material?
Is the secondary text outlined rather than solid?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the red light leak
mustRedesign: Avoid using any specific artist names or logos
Ensure the background trees are silhouetted and not detailed

mustAchieve: Cinematic lighting on the subject's face
Seamless color transition between blue and red

postGenerationChecks: Check for high contrast between white text and background
Verify the subject's beard texture is sharp
Ensure the red gradient does not overpower the subject's face
Confirm the outlined text is legible
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Blue/Red Split Grade + Bold/Outlined Sans-Serif Overlay
